name: Faster Mod Loader - no disk check per picture
author: Anders
description: With the mod loader on, the game looks in every mod folder on disk for each picture and sound it loads, in case a mod replaces it. This mod reads the mod folders once at start-up and answers those checks from memory, which removes a delay that grows with the number of mods. It also writes frames that take longer than 0.4 seconds to mods-slow-frames.log in the game folder, to help track down freezes. Edit the CONFIG block in js/plugins/FasterModLoader.js.
